name: Yueye Xia de Hongcha Bei
source:
Blacktea With Moon is a visual novel style fan game of Touhou Project. The main story line of the game will deep into the love story of the two main protagonists who are Sakuya and Remilia. Players will play as both Sakuya and Remilia in the game and the story begins and focus on the day after Sakuya arrived Scarlet Devil Mansion.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/836490/]Steam[/url]]
